headline: The measured movements still fall short of purposeful skills.
change: The first corrected prediction study finished and failed its accuracy gate. Specific input and contact-learning repairs are now being implemented; live training continues.

jobs.title: Can the repaired predictor distinguish movements and touches?
jobs.question: Compare the declared body-coordinate and action-difference repairs while sharing learning across body and skin sites.
jobs.when: Implemented and independently reviewed; development experiment declared. Launch follows the current commit and resource check.
jobs.result: 21 tests and recorded-packet learning/save/reload passed. The full development comparison and fresh-world confirmation have not run.
jobs.decision: Compare the repairs under a declared development experiment, then confirm in new worlds before any decision about integration.
jobs.scope: This is a separate predictor. No production weights, reward or body control are changed.

jobs.title: Can sensed body history predict a complete move?
jobs.question: Can a separate predictor learn body and contact consequences from the saved brain's sensed history?
jobs.when: Completed; fixed-result review and implementation of located readout gaps follow.
jobs.result: The previous audit mixed an old encoder with newer predictor weights and saw only the first 50 milliseconds of 250-millisecond commands. Its scores cannot establish complete-learner progress.
jobs.decision: Use compatible representations and complete executed sequences. Compare fixed physical outcomes with unchanged-state, action-blind and shuffled-action controls before any chooser activation.
jobs.scope: Separate auxiliary predictor using the saved brain's own sensory encoding. Its failure does not establish inability of the live brain. It cannot authorize physical action.

jobs.title: Does local pressure actually reduce sensing here?
jobs.question: Check force, contact site, sensor area and actual sensory change at the same physical instant.
jobs.scope: Contact and release are controllable and replay exactly. This fixture does not establish purposeful recovery or a calibrated biological pressure response.
jobs.decision: Repair contact-footprint modelling with declared virtual skin assumptions; do not lower a pain threshold just to pass.

jobs.title: Can these muscles physically turn the whole body?
jobs.question: Search actual mature-body command sequences under the same force, timing and smoothing limits.
jobs.scope: Physics-only search and independent exact replay, with no trained brain. Peak body contact was 266.5 N; this is not an infant pain calibration. Failure to find a full roll in a bounded search does not prove impossibility.
jobs.decision: Use the side-roll as a mechanical diagnostic. Continue full-roll reachability analysis; do not claim the learner has rolled.

jobs.title: Can it tell how a move changes its functioning?
jobs.question: Test the copied one-second forecast on eight fresh worlds, separating skin and muscle-capacity consequences.
jobs.scope: The fitting data predates the newly connected spatial regions. Low average error cannot conceal the weakest local site. No gate was lowered after seeing these worlds.
jobs.decision: Continue the grounded/spatial learner; repair contact information and evidence. No new chooser activation from this result.

jobs.title: What does a trained copy actually do?
jobs.question: Run the six already-defined behavior tests on the first finished caregiver-trained copy, so its movements can be measured before the whole comparison ends.
jobs.work_units: Six fixed tests: visible/absent object, returning/absent adult, matching/wrong speech cue.
jobs.decision: Report all responses and misses. The full caregiver-versus-replay study still decides whether the adult improved learning.
jobs.scope: One frozen copied learner. These measurements do not establish learning benefit or a new ability in the live baby. Separate CPU process and output directory; original study unchanged.

jobs.title: Does a responding adult improve learning?
jobs.question: Compare learning with an adult who responds to this baby against replaying an adult's interaction with another baby.
jobs.decision: Measure whether responsive interaction improves object following beyond replay. Use the size and consistency of that change to decide which caregiver interactions to retain or revise.
jobs.scope: 24 copied learners, then 144 frozen behavior tests across matched worlds. Tests include moving, absent and returning objects, plus matching versus wrong speech cues. The primary comparison is object following. This tests a bounded amount of experience; it does not settle the full future value of a caregiver. Production training continues separately. Current hold: copied visual reproducibility is under diagnosis and additional recording headroom is required; 8 of 24 copied learners are complete. See the readiness record for measured remaining storage.
jobs.when: Resume after exact copied continuation is verified and storage admission passes; no defensible completion time yet.

jobs.title: Can it recognize a struggling body part?
jobs.question: The site's actual function is already in its input. Does the learned self-model retain that distinction?
jobs.scope: Eight saved development scenes, copied module and optimizer history, 120 present-state updates per arm. No untouched-world confirmation. Focusing the lesson on the weakest site improved some local errors but degraded the overall body prediction, so that change is rejected.

jobs.title: Can it forecast how movement changes function?
jobs.question: Given candidate movements, predict the resulting availability of sensing and bodily capacity.
jobs.scope: Eight development and eight untouched worlds; eight movements each. The declared criterion accepted any positive reduction in action-effect error. That numerical result is retained, but its magnitude is too small to support adoption. The fixture also lacked the source-removal recovery opportunity needed to test purposeful relief.

jobs.title: A local readout recovers the missing distinction
jobs.question: Can the existing body representation distinguish affected sites from healthy ones if we repair its readout?
jobs.scope: Fit a small local readout on seven development worlds and test on the eighth, repeated for all eight. The existing brain weights remain unchanged. This diagnoses accessible current-state information, not movement forecasting or a deployed fix. These development worlds are not untouched confirmation.

jobs.title: Repair current and future self-state learning
jobs.question: Can continued learning with actual sensor-function changes retain local distinctions and predict movement outcomes?
jobs.decision: Keep learning from actual modulated experience; test fresh action contrasts separately from present-state readout.
jobs.scope: Software and continuity verified. Grounded observed function is not learned self-awareness. The newest copied forecast still fails its practical action prediction gate.
jobs.result: Added local grounding, temporal action forecasts and real spatial regions. All 364 old tensors and 308 Adam histories preserved.

jobs.title: Keep the qualified chooser usable during learning
jobs.question: Can a validated acting copy keep controlling the body while a separate learner updates and qualifies its next replacement?
jobs.when: Implemented and tested on native grown-body save/resume.
jobs.decision: Require actual acquisition or restoration benefit before replacing the current chooser.
jobs.scope: 60 focused actor/opportunity/qualification tests passed. Healthy discovery uses completed controlled learning evidence; noise and forgetting do not count as progress. No new acting license was issued.
jobs.result: A frozen actor stays unchanged while its learner updates; qualified candidates can be staged and promoted with their own history.

jobs.title: Does scheduled stillness help or obstruct?
jobs.question: The timer repeatedly overrides body commands. Does removing that override preserve or improve learned behavior?
jobs.when: Running since 2026-09-13 17:56:58 at D:/UEMA_Research/external/D/UEMA_recordings/stillness_learning_comparison_20260913 after the storage blocker was resolved; the caregiver comparison remains paused on its source-version check.
jobs.decision: Compare copied learners with and without forced holds while keeping the exploration schedule equal. Judge goal completion and retention, not movement amount or prediction error alone.
jobs.scope: Compare retained target-following and body function; posture/contact observations are also recorded. No schedule verdict from movement amount alone.
jobs.result: The optimizer validator is fixed. The shared continuation passed 13 exact native recorded-input checks; 38 focused software checks include stillness schedule and remaining learning/retention budgets. The full eight-pair comparison is now running with unchanged budgets; no schedule verdict is claimed.
